promise.en: A credible senior face in Indonesia for the six to eighteen months before your country manager is in place.
promise.id: Wajah senior yang kredibel di Indonesia selama enam hingga delapan belas bulan sebelum country manager Anda siap.

metaDescription.en: Fractional country manager in Indonesia, two to three days a week: pipeline, partner management, hiring the permanent GM, board reporting.
metaDescription.id: Country manager paruh waktu di Indonesia, dua hingga tiga hari seminggu: pipeline, pengelolaan mitra, perekrutan GM tetap, pelaporan dewan.

who.en: Entrants who have decided to proceed but have no one on the ground yet
who.id: Pendatang yang telah memutuskan lanjut tetapi belum memiliki orang di lapangan

who.en: Funds that need a local operator for a portfolio company's first year
who.id: Dana investasi yang membutuhkan operator lokal untuk tahun pertama perusahaan portofolio

who.en: Companies that want the people who built the entry case to run its first year
who.id: Perusahaan yang ingin orang-orang penyusun kajian masuk menjalankan tahun pertamanya

get.en: A senior lead on the ground two to three days a week
get.id: Pemimpin senior di lapangan dua hingga tiga hari seminggu

get.en: Pipeline, partner and distributor management, key-account meetings
get.id: Pengelolaan pipeline, mitra, dan distributor; pertemuan key account

get.en: Hiring and onboarding of the permanent general manager
get.id: Perekrutan dan orientasi general manager tetap

get.en: Monthly board reporting in the format your HQ already uses
get.id: Pelaporan dewan bulanan dalam format yang sudah dipakai kantor pusat Anda

get.en: Compliance back-office (LKPM, tax, payroll) through a white-label partner, one point of contact
get.id: Back office kepatuhan (LKPM, pajak, penggajian) melalui mitra berlabel putih, satu titik kontak

getSummary.en: Senior presence 2–3 days a week; pipeline, partners, hiring, board reporting
getSummary.id: Kehadiran senior 2–3 hari seminggu; pipeline, mitra, perekrutan, pelaporan dewan

duration.en: Six-month minimum; typically six to eighteen months
duration.id: Minimum enam bulan; umumnya enam hingga delapan belas bulan

how.en: Monthly retainer with partner days stated explicitly. We stay if you keep us; we hand over when your team is ready.
how.id: Retainer bulanan dengan hari kerja partner dinyatakan eksplisit. Kami tetap mendampingi jika Anda menghendaki; kami menyerahkan saat tim Anda siap.

next.en: Handover to your general manager with a documented pipeline, partner file and board pack.
next.id: Serah terima kepada general manager Anda dengan pipeline, berkas mitra, dan materi dewan yang terdokumentasi.
